events.title: Kumamoto Castle
events.description: One of Japan’s great castles—resilient symbol under restoration after the 2016 earthquakes.

events.title: Suizenji Jōju-en Garden
events.description: Strolling garden with a spring-fed pond and miniature ‘Mt. Fuji’ hill—tea pavilions and arched bridges.

events.title: Daikanbō (Aso Panorama)
events.description: Wind-swept ridge viewpoint over the five peaks of Mt. Aso and the vast caldera.
